facts.fact: Clover（Beau 的妹妹）把车半个停在草地上；Dad 每个星期二都抱怨她毁了他的草坪。
facts.anchor: despite Dad complaining every Tuesday that she was destroying his lawn

facts.fact: Mom 指责 Dad 吃了三个她原本守着的面包卷。
Jax 不得不听 Mrs. Baker 讲她狗的消化问题讲了十五分钟。
facts.anchor: I had to listen to Mrs. Baker explain her dog’s digestive issues for fifteen minutes

facts.fact: Clover 二十五岁，是几个孩子里最小的；她端着一篮玉米面包，用肩膀撞了 Beau 一下。
facts.anchor: At twenty-five, she was the youngest of us

facts.fact: Hunter（Clover 的丈夫）走路时把义肢手臂自然地搭在 Clover 腰间，义肢腿让他的步态略微不稳。
facts.anchor: resting his prosthetic arm naturally at Clover’s waist

facts.fact: Dad 告诉 Beau 那辆黑色方体皮卡是 James 的——James 在 Carson 出生前买下它，并说要留给「那孩子」（Carson）。
facts.anchor: He bought it before Carson was born.

facts.fact: Clover 说 Beau 已经提到 Carson 的名字七次。
facts.anchor: you’ve mentioned her name seven times

facts.fact: Dad 说 James 帮他造了第一辆拖车，为了完工连续熬了两个晚上，一分钱都没收。
facts.anchor: Stayed up two nights straight because I couldn’t afford to close the shop long enough to finish it myself
